_meta.author: Moragar
_meta.notes: American English source. Translators copy this file to de.json (and the other language files), keep every key, and replace only the string values. Do not translate keys. Placeholders look like {0} {1} {name} {count}. Keep them. Do not wrap Horizon-owned strings in $ tokens. Game item names and $EMPTY SLOT stay with the game.

chrome.restartRequired: Takes effect after you restart the game.

language.label: LANGUAGE
language.help: Language for Horizon labels, Settings, and Quick Menu. Auto follows the game language. Changing this and pressing OK reloads the language once. Game item names and the game's own $ tokens stay in the game language.

QuickMenuHorizon.label: HORIZON STYLE
QuickMenuHorizon.help: The game's quick menu (favorites cross) as Horizon cards in your colors and font. Off is the game's look.
